rules: RUSH. PRODUCTION_SPEC §12–§18; flat LIGHT backgrounds only; Rockstar official images only (shotlist.md A–F) as framed rounded cards — NO trailer/gameplay footage, no clips at all, no Rockstar music, no fan art; crops avoid weapons; 1–3 words on screen; a detailed 2-D object in every shot; watermark below content; logo v5 end card; audio LOCKED (narrate.py + mix.sh). Length 50–58 s. Tone: FUN — playful timing on 'your midnight', 'forty-five DVDs', 'just a code, in a box'.
palette_for_this_video: paper #FAF8F5 main; lavender #ECE8FB for time/size beats; blush #FBE7E2 for THE CATCH; marigold object fills (GTA VI bar highlight); ember price figures; wreck red only for the slash/stamp
new_objects: downloadBar (screen.js), dvdStack (objects.js), gameCase + disc (objects.js), consoleTower (hardware.js, generic unbranded) — add all to render/kit/OBJECTS.md index
